title: VN Expression v1
description: An OPTIONAL expression preset (expressions/<id>.json). Names overrides of a pack's expression slots (eyes/brows/mouth) by partId — applied at compose for preview-only. See hugmesh-vn-character-b0-scaffold (EXPRESSION-PREVIEW slice).

slots.description: slot → partId override; partId MUST exist as a part in that slot of the pack.
